nostr.intro: Sign in passwordlessly by proving control of your Nostr key with a browser extension (NIP-07).

my_site.title: My site
my_site.intro: Publish and manage your NIP-5A site (nsite) on this server.
my_site.signer_hint: Sign in with the same Nostr key you want to publish under. The site is signed in your browser with this signer, so the server never sees your key.
my_site.extension_missing: No Nostr extension found. Install one or use a remote signer (bunker://).
my_site.linked_warning: This signer is not one of your linked Nostr identities. An administrator must grant nsites.read and nsites.publish scopes to this pubkey before you can use it here.
my_site.your_sites_hint: Sites published under your key on this server.
my_site.read_scope_missing: You do not have the nsites.read scope yet. Ask an administrator to grant it so you can list your sites.
my_site.no_sites: No registered sites under this key yet.
my_site.publish_hint: Pick the folder of your site (static files, no empty blobs, files up to 32 MiB). Files are hashed and uploaded to your Blossom servers, then the manifest is signed and broadcast. An administrator must first grant you the nsites.read and nsites.publish scopes and register your pubkey (hosted mode) — or the gateway must be in open mode.
my_site.plan_ready: Manifest built. Review it, then publish.
my_site.plan_failed: Could not build the manifest. Do you have the nsites.read scope?
my_site.publish_rejected: The server rejected the published site.
